channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: In tourist-weary Kyoto, U.S. college targets deeper ties between students and residents
item.description: Pepperdine University's new year-round Japan program aims to give students an immersive experience while they continue their usual areas of study.

item.title: Scottish teen chases judo dreams through unique Japanese homestay
item.description: Teenager Lexi Buchanan puts in around four hours of work each day, balancing weightlifting with sparring alongside university athletes.

item.title: As Yokohama’s Green Expo nears, organizers draw inspiration from the past
item.description: From cutting-edge tech to lessons from the Edo Period, the six-month event will seek to help develop solutions to the planet's environmental crises.

item.title: Joint Japan-U.S. military drill set to break new ground
item.description: The Keen Sword military exercises will see Japan deploy longer-range missiles, while the U.S. will send advanced weapons to Okinawa's Yonaguni Island.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
